description: Pass 0b: Somatic feature extraction with three-tier architecture

segments.description: Enriched segments, one per input segment, in order

id.description: Segment ID matching the input segment

mechanical_directive.description: The explicit physical command or description of what the segment is (if not a movement)

quality_constraint.description: Adjectives, metaphors, or modifiers that shape effort or movement quality

global_anchor.description: Connection between local movement and distant skeletal foundation (optional)

intent.description: Pedagogical purpose: the learning strategy behind this instruction
